# gezor_sso_group_mappings (Resource)

Maps identity provider groups to workspace roles for one SSO provider. Manages the full list; destroying it clears the mappings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_roles" "all" {}

resource "gezor_sso_group_mappings" "entra" {
  provider_id = gezor_sso_provider.entra.id

  mapping = [
    { idp_group = "gezor-admins", role_id = data.gezor_roles.all.by_key["admin"] },
    { idp_group = "data-engineering", role_id = gezor_role.data_engineer.id },
  ]

  default_role_id = data.gezor_roles.all.by_key["viewer"]
  sync_groups     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) SSO provider id.

### Optional

- `default_role_id` (String) Role for people who match no group.
- `mapping` (Attributes List) Group to role mappings, checked in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mapping))
- `sync_groups` (Boolean) Update a person's role from their groups at every sign-in.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `provider_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mapping`

Required:

- `idp_group` (String) Group name or id sent by the identity provider.
- `role_id` (String) Workspace role id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Append @<workspace> to import from a workspace other than the provider default.
terraform import gezor_sso_group_mappings.example <provider_id>
```
